note: Explicit connection instances derived from the members and joinery authored in tools/author_house.py. Points are in the assembled pose, metres, Y up.

sill-corner.title: Sill corner
sill-corner.description: The two 土台 sill members are halved across each other, alternating which wall keeps the top half.

post-sill.title: Post on sill
post-sill.description: A through tenon on the post passes down through the sill and is wedged below it.

catalog.title: Shitakone-hozo-wari-kusabi
catalog.jp: 下小根ホゾ割り楔打ち

post-beam.title: Beam into post
post-beam.description: A housed tenon at the end of the beam is pinned through the post with a komisen peg.

catalog.title: Naga-hozo-sashi-komisen-uchi
catalog.jp: 長ホゾ差し込み栓打ち

nuki-post.title: 貫 into post
nuki-post.description: The 包み込み貫 is housed into the post and wedged on the outer face; the post keeps a shelf under the nuki's rebated end.

nuki-stud.title: 貫 through stud
nuki-stud.description: The nuki passes through a slot in the stud, interrupting the stud rather than the nuki.

brace.title: Brace into post
brace.description: The 筋違 brace is let into the post face; its own thickness forms the housing and no peg is used.

fire-beam.title: 火打梁 tie
fire-beam.description: A diagonal 火打梁 ties the two sill or girder members across the corner, resting on both.

joist-sleeper.title: Joist half-lap
joist-sleeper.description: The 根太 joist and the 大引 sleeper are halved 30 mm each where they cross.

joist-sill.title: Joist into sill
joist-sill.description: The joist end is housed 30 mm into the sill.

floorpost-sleeper.title: 床束 into sleeper
floorpost-sleeper.description: The short 床束 floor post tenons up into the 大引 sleeper.

floorpost-stone.title: 床束 on stone
floorpost-stone.description: The 床束 floor post bears on its foundation stone.

sleeper-sill.title: Sleeper into sill
sleeper-sill.description: The 大引 sleeper end is housed into the end sill.

upperjoist-beam.title: Upper joist half-lap
upperjoist-beam.description: The upper 根太 is halved over the spine beam.

upperjoist-girder.title: Upper joist into girder
upperjoist-girder.description: The upper joist end is housed into the 胴差 girder.

roofbeam-plate.title: 小屋梁 into plate
roofbeam-plate.description: The roof beam tenons into the inner face of the 軒桁 plate.

roofpost-beam.title: Roof post on beam
roofpost-beam.description: The 小屋束 or 真束 tenons down into the top of the roof beam.

roofpost-purlin.title: 母屋 over roof post
roofpost-purlin.description: The purlin is notched over the tenoned top of the roof post.

roofpost-ridge.title: 真束 into ridge
roofpost-ridge.description: The king post tenons into the ridge, which is notched over it.

purlin-hip.title: Purlin under hip
purlin-hip.description: The 母屋 purlin end carries the 隅木 hip rafter where their lines cross.

ridge-hip.title: Hip into ridge
ridge-hip.description: The 隅木 hip rafter butts the end of the ridge.

hip-plate.title: Hip over plate
hip-plate.description: The hip rafter passes over the corner where the two 軒桁 plates meet.

rafter-ridge.title: Rafter at ridge
rafter-ridge.description: The common rafter butts the ridge at the top of the slope.

rafter-hip.title: Rafter at hip
rafter-hip.description: The common rafter is cut square against the hip rafter.

rafter-purlin.title: Rafter over purlin
rafter-purlin.description: A birdsmouth notch seats the rafter over the 母屋 purlin.

rafter-plate.title: Rafter over plate
rafter-plate.description: A birdsmouth notch seats the rafter over the 軒桁 plate.

jack-hip.title: Jack rafter at hip
jack-hip.description: The jack rafter is cut square against the hip rafter.

jack-plate.title: Jack rafter over plate
jack-plate.description: The jack rafter is notched over the 軒桁 plate at the hipped end.
